about: The real-world Word corpus (plan section 10): published documents and blank templates from reputable publishers. The files aren't in the repository, because their licences vary; scripts/fetch-corpus.ps1 downloads them into FW_CORPUS, checks each hash and screens each file. Only hosts on the sources list are allowed, including after redirects.
layout: docx/<category>/<id>.docx; Word's PDFs in reference/docx/<category>/<id>.docx.pdf with reference/manifest.json

categories.forms: form templates, with content controls or legacy form fields
categories.reports: reports and guidance with headings, numbered lists and a table of contents
categories.academic: papers and thesis templates: columns, footnotes, equations
categories.tables: invoices, budgets and other table-heavy documents
categories.manuals: manuals, guides, brochures and newsletters with pictures and text boxes
categories.legal: contracts, policies, procurement documents and legislation with multi-level numbering
categories.review: documents with comments or tracked changes
